page.layout: One printed page, one text column; margin notes in the right margin; running head at the top; catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: verum magistratus vice suâ judicare voluit, adeoque eos ut justitiæ ministros, ad opera justitiæ expediendâ, adhibuit. Unde etiam ultorem gladium Rom. 13. gerere dicuntur, non secundum propriam jurisdictionem, sed demandatam. Ut non tam censeantur habere vindicandi jus, quam quidem illius juris concessam[?] sibi exercitionem. Quæ etiam ratio, quod Moises dixerit Israelitis, non ut semet (licet ipsi injuriam essent passi) sed ut Deum vindicarent super Midianitis. Ut omnis vindicta Deo sit committenda, aut ejus executio illi, cujus manubus; ut prorectori[?], gladium concredidit.
Peccant ulterius in Deum isti duellatores, ut qui hanc legem inter nos servari voluit, ut non tantum amicos, sed etiam inimicos diligamus, in eos bene affecti simus, ac ma-v.1.2.3.4.lum

page.notes: Right margin: "Rom. 13." beside the line with "gladium"; "v.1.2.3.4." beside "non secun-" with "4." on the following line. Small stray marks in the right margin (a dot beside "gladium" and near "concredidit") are not text and are omitted. The word "concessam" has a doubtful ligature at "ss" and is marked [?]. "prorectori" is doubtful in the scan and marked [?]. The catchword "lum" completes "ma-" at the line end. Printed "justitiæ" and "ministros" are given with plain s and u/v/i/j normalised. Printed "suâ" and "expediendâ" are kept as printed, the latter with a doubtful final vowel; the printed text ends "expedienda," and is copied as printed with the comma.
